quotes.text: Stripe determines whether to present the redirect or the button
Shipping address collection is enabled (for recurring payments)
PayPal is the only payment method type

old_evidence.text: For recurring payments with the PayPal button, you must explicitly define `billingAddressRequired` as `false`.

findings: Both captures describe Stripe choosing PayPal button versus redirect in Express Checkout Element and Stripe Checkout, with merchants able to improve the chance through configuration and advised to use a PayPal Sandbox account for tests (old 6-16; new 7-17). This is presentation eligibility, independent of completed payment, buyer authentication, capture or payout.

November ECE mentions phone collection and shipping collection for recurring payments as scenarios without the PayPal button. HTML/JS and React show phoneNumberRequired:false and shippingAddressRequired:false, with the inline one-off shipping qualification. May additionally listed billing-address collection and expressly required billingAddressRequired:false for recurring, and pictured the key in both examples. November omits this authority rather than documenting a contrary runtime rule (old 18-46; new 19-44).

Stripe Checkout offers the button out of the box and falls back to PayPal redirect where listed blockers apply: billing or consent collection, custom fields, PayPal-only method, phone, recurring shipping or tax-ID collection. May Node and November cURL create a one-time EUR example with automatic tax disabled and billing_address_collection=auto. November drops May's explicit card/PayPal array; it retains the PayPal-only blocker and introduces no new required method-selection field (old 48-90; new 46-73).

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/paypal-button, Stripe chooses the PayPal button or a redirect. November's Express Checkout Element guidance flags phone collection and recurring shipping collection and illustrates disabling those options. May also lists billing collection as a blocker and explicitly sets billingAddressRequired to false for recurring payments (old raw lines 18-46; new raw lines 19-44). In Checkout both guides give redirect fallback for billing or consent collection, custom fields, PayPal alone, phone collection, recurring shipping collection or tax-ID collection. November's cURL still sets payment mode, automatic tax false and billing address collection auto, but omits May's explicit card and PayPal list (old raw lines 48-90; new raw lines 46-73). source-stripe-paypal-button.md describes the May configuration and should date its ECE advice. Presentation and Sandbox setup do not establish a successful payment.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/paypal-button, November's omission of ECE billing-address text and both example fields is a substantive documentation difference, while actual ECE support remains unresolved (old raw lines 20-44; new raw lines 21-42). Keep the May 7 requirement in source-stripe-paypal-button.md as dated, alongside the separately scoped ECE payer-information caveat and the unchanged Checkout billing condition. November's omission of explicit card and PayPal selection changes the illustrated Checkout request, although switching from Node to cURL is presentational (old raw lines 48-90; new raw lines 46-73). Preserve the PayPal-only redirect rule, qualify version-specific Checkout create fields using the separate Endive note, and keep reciprocal links to the Stripe wallet and Express Checkout Element concepts and related guides.
